_schema.semantic_mix: DEMANDED mix over built cells; rule: residential split by doctrine height regime (>=18 m -> residential_estate else residential_lowrise); civic split per the doctrine's NAMED institutions; commercial/industrial from designated cells. office_finance=0 everywhere: no doctrine allocates office land inside the residential unit (VR banishes it to the business band, out of window).
